questions.qtext:
A disinfectant kills and inactivates the pathogen by:
(i) Damaging the cell wall of pathogen
(ii) Mutating the DNA and RNA of pathogens' cells
(iii) Inhibiting the activity of enzymes
(iv) Mutating the cell wall permeability
(v) Altering the cell's protoplasm
Of the above statements, the correct ones are:
questions.solution:
(d)
All of the above mechanisms aid in inactivating or killing the pathogens by the use of disinfectant.

Consider the following statements:
(i) In effluent irrigation, treated waste water is used.
(ii) In sewage farming, untreated or partially treated waste water is used.
Which of the above statements are incorrect ?
questions.solution:
(d)
In effluent irrigation, treated waste water is used with main motive of waste water disposal.
In sewage farming, untreated or partially treated waste water is used with main motive as cultivation of crops.

questions.qtext:
The following items consists of two statements, one labelled as Statement (I) and the other labelled as Statement (II). You have to examine these two statements carefully and select your answers to these items using the codes given below:
Codes:
(a) Both Statement (I) and Statement (II) are true and Statement (II) is the correct explanation of Statement (I).
(b) Both Statement (I) and Statement (II) are true but Statement (II) is not a correct explanation of Statement (I).
(c) Statement (I) is true but Statement (II) is false.
(d) Statement (I) is false but Statement (II) is true.

Statement (I): Water obtained from zeolite process is suitable for public water supplies.
Statement (II): Water obtained from zeolite process is of zero hardness.
questions.solution:
(d)
Statement I is false as water obtained from zeolite process is not suitable for public water supplies
as it results in water of zero hardness.
